items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Phil Woods is on that. I have him on clarinet on that.

ctx.x: He was the music guy here. I said, “Larry, what’s with Puccini?” He said, here’s all the scores; here’s all the records. I spent the whole winter, whenever this was. I listened, I picked out my 11 or 12 tunes, I reharmonized them, and that’s how the Puccini date came out. Phil Woods is on that. I have him on clarinet on that.
